author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam attends the premiere of The Mandalorian and Grogu and gives his spoiler-free reaction to the film! Paying special attention to the Grogu puppet on the big screen, Adam learns more about how to puppet his own animatronic, and gets his chance to meet Grogu's team of puppeteers on the red carpet. Plus, we unbox the new Hot Toys life-size Grogu with his accessories from the film!

Hot Toys Life-Size Grogu from The Mandalorian and Grogu: https://www.sideshow.com/collectibles/star-wars-grogu-hot-toys-915301
Sideshow's Grogu accessories set: https://www.sideshow.com/collectibles/star-wars-the-child-sideshow-collectibles-400369?var=700259
Disclosure: This product was sent to us by the manufacturer for purposes of review. 

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
